insights.one_liner: Van Caem Klerks Group is an Amsterdam trader of branded liquor, cosmetics and consumer goods; its sales internship needs no Dutch, but it is not a visa sponsor.

culture.text: An import-export trading company with over 50 years of experience, buying and selling branded liquor, fragrance, cosmetics and FMCG goods.
Its head office is in central Amsterdam, with an office in Curaçao and two warehouses near the Port of Rotterdam.
Its one open job here is a sales and account management internship in Amsterdam.

open.text: It is not on the IND list of recognised visa sponsors.
Its current job here does not require Dutch.
